summary: Frontend-only smoke + integration testing of the Rishabh & Ritul Next.js 16 wedding invitation site. All requested flows pass end-to-end via the public preview URL. Envelope opens correctly (tap-to-open with ~1.8s reveal); hero shows names, Om, blessing, date '04 DECEMBER 2026' and '07:00 PM'; navbar smooth-scrolls to gallery & rsvp; all 7 sections render visible (opacity=1) after scroll reveal; 4 event cards present; countdown ticks two-digit values (days/hours/minutes/seconds); gallery lightbox opens with next/prev/close working (image src changes on next, returns on prev); RSVP form submits, confirmation shown ('Thank You, Test!'), reset returns to form (localStorage-only, no backend call); music button toggles aria-label Play<->Pause without JS errors; venue shows Riwaaz/Sector 07/Dwarka/110045 + 1 QR image; family shows all four parent names (Kalyani, Rakesh, Pragya, Mithilesh, Jha, Thakur). Floating petals visible. No pageerrors or console errors observed.

issues: Number-of-guests <select> renders native browser dropdown (not the site's shadcn/custom style), and shows an italic 'I' placeholder-looking glyph in the closed state due to serif italic font-family applied to <select>. Consider a styled custom dropdown or overriding font-style on select.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Style the RSVP guests <select> so it doesn't render with italic serif font that makes '1' look like an 'I' in the closed state.
critical_code_review_comments: ScrollReveal 2.5s safety-net fallback is a good defensive measure given the Motion migration; sections were all visible in prod build.
Music track is an external SoundHelix placeholder MP3 - acceptable as noted, but consider self-hosting to avoid third-party outages.
RSVP persistence is localStorage-only; if the couple wants to actually collect responses, a backend endpoint should be added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL: https://3b4869f3-f093-44f0-b565-89b85a484c1d.preview.emergentagent.com . Append '#open' to shortcut past the envelope. Use domcontentloaded (not networkidle) because the music player streams audio and networkidle will time out. All data-testids listed in the review request are present and working.
